evidence.why: Complete signature, condition, entry call and returns.

facts.rationale: Replace success/orientation assumptions with exact signature and observable dispatch contract.
facts.value: bool(Fighter_GObj* gobj), a state-changing input predicate: true reports that the local entry helper was called; false reports no local transition. It assumes a valid fighter object and does not validate the source motion.

facts.rationale: Avoid implying input consumption or a locally checked orientation precondition.
facts.value: Checks a DownStand request for the DownWait input path and dispatches the selected DownStand motion. It reads input without clearing it; DownWaitU selects DownStandU and every other source ID selects DownStandD.

facts.rationale: State the complete guard and unrestricted else branch.
facts.value: Accepts (lstick[0].y >= x244 and atan2f(Y,ABS(X)) >= x20_radians) or nonzero pressed_buttons & HSD_PAD_LR. Equality is accepted; analog conjunction and button alternative short-circuit. On acceptance, exactly DownWaitU selects DownStandU, otherwise DownStandD; entry precedes true. Rejection returns false without entry. Input is not cleared and no finite-value or groundedness check is made.

facts.rationale: Correct the baseline no-blend claim and include all observed callers.
facts.value: Shared unguarded motion-entry wrapper used for DownStand by input, DownWait timeout and grounded DownDamage completion callers. It forwards the caller's ID with Ft_MF_None, start 0, speed 1, blend argument 0 and NULL alternate fighter; blend argument 0 selects animation-data defaults, not guaranteed no blending.

facts.rationale: Separate argument values from consumer semantics and complete caller coverage.
facts.value: Forwards gobj and msid unchanged to Fighter_ChangeMotionState with Ft_MF_None, anim_start=0, anim_speed=1, anim_blend=0 and alternate fighter=NULL. Observed callers select U/D from DownWait input, DownWait timer expiration, and non-air DownDamage completion with expired timer. NULL uses the receiving fighter's animation data; zero blend is replaced by that animation's metadata default when animation setup runs.

facts.rationale: Correct blend semantics and clarify state/callback effects.
facts.value: Always calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState for the supplied motion ID without eligibility or ID-range checks. Requests start 0 and speed 1 with no motion flags. Its zero blend argument permits animation-metadata blending; it does not force zero blend. The motion machinery replaces the fighter's active callback pointers from the selected table entry.

facts.rationale: Prove assignment and behavior without inferring that a non-null slot is mandatory or proving global interruptibility.
facts.value: Supplies the empty input/IASA callback assigned to both common DownStand table entries; it offers no input-driven transition through this callback.

facts.rationale: Remove implication that animation must be the eventual or sole exit.
facts.value: Every invocation is a no-op: the parameter is ignored and there are no reads, writes, calls or local transitions. Other paths can end DownStand, including the animation callback's completion dispatch and collision delegation's conditional Fall entry.

facts.rationale: Correct magnitude wording and document complete local flow without compiled layout assertions.
facts.value: The input path reads signed left-stick Y, folded angle atan2f(Y,ABS(X)), pressed HSD_PAD_LR bits, common thresholds and motion_id. Exactly DownWaitU selects DownStandU; otherwise DownStandD. Entry forwards the object/ID with flags none, start 0, speed 1, blend argument 0 and NULL alternate fighter. Animation, physics and collision callbacks forward the same borrowed object to shared helpers; IASA ignores it.

facts.rationale: Complete caller/callback coverage and correct blanket orientation, blend and sole-exit assumptions.
facts.value: Accepted analog-threshold or pressed-LR input dispatches DownStandU only from exact DownWaitU, otherwise DownStandD; rejected input returns false without entry. Entry is unconditional and uses metadata-default blending via blend argument 0. Both DownStand table entries use the same callbacks: animation conditionally calls the common action-ending dispatcher, IASA is empty, physics delegates ground friction/movement, and collision delegates a check that can enter Fall. DownWait timeout and grounded expired DownDamage completion also use the entry helper.
